skill.name: famulor-skill
skill.description: Operate a Famulor workspace through its hosted MCP server, including assistants, conversation history, campaigns, messaging, telephony, knowledge, dashboards, automations, billing, settings, reseller administration, migrations, and long-running tasks. Use for requests that need actual Famulor data or actions; do not use for generic voice-agent advice that is unrelated to Famulor.
skill.summary: Manage Famulor assistants, communications, campaigns, knowledge, settings, and operations through a scoped hosted MCP connection.
skill.author: bekservice

security_audit.summary: All 66 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, documented MCP tool names, URL examples, or explicit safety guidance. No executable shell code, filesystem traversal, environment access, prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious intent was found. The skill still exposes powerful authenticated operations, so users must review targets, scopes, costs, and destructive effects before authorization.

content.value_statement: Famulor administration spans many connected tools, records, and sensitive actions. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through scoped MCP operations with authorization checks.
actual_capabilities: Connects to Famulor through its hosted Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint.
Routes requests to focused toolsets for assistants, calls, campaigns, messaging, telephony, knowledge, dashboards, and automations.
Reads current workspace state before proposing or applying changes.
Creates, updates, tests, and verifies Famulor assistants using live schemas and catalogs.
Manages authorized communications, campaigns, workspace settings, billing workflows, migrations, and long-running tasks.
Tracks asynchronous task status and verifies completed operations through returned results or read-back calls.
limitations: Requires a configured Famulor MCP connection and valid OAuth or workspace credentials.
Available tools depend on account scopes, role, plan, consent, and workspace policy.
Cannot operate Famulor when the MCP server is unavailable.
External actions may send communications, change data, incur charges, or create irreversible effects.

use_cases.title: Configure a Voice Assistant
use_cases.description: Review live models, voices, tools, and knowledge before creating or updating a tested assistant.

use_cases.title: Review Customer Communications
use_cases.description: Retrieve authorized call, email, and messaging history while limiting personal data to the requested purpose.

use_cases.title: Prepare Controlled Outreach
use_cases.description: Check recipients, consent, suppression, templates, schedules, and limits before launching a campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Recent Calls
prompt_templates.prompt: List my five most recent Famulor calls and summarize their status and outcomes. Keep this request read-only.

prompt_templates.title: Draft an Assistant Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the current assistant named [name]. Propose improvements for [goal], preserve existing tools, and wait for approval before saving.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a [channel] campaign for [audience]. Check consent, suppression, template status, schedule, and limits, but do not start it.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Workspace Operations
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [toolsets] for configuration risks, stale resources, and failed tasks. Report recommended changes, costs, and impacts without applying mutations.

output_examples.output: Three calls were found. Two completed successfully, and one ended without a booking. The failed booking requires calendar availability review.

output_examples.input: Improve our booking assistant but do not save changes.
output: The current assistant uses the approved English voice and one calendar integration.
The proposed prompt adds confirmation and escalation rules while preserving assigned tools.

output_examples.output: The campaign remains a draft. Recipient consent passed, two contacts are suppressed, and the selected template is approved.

best_practices: Use the smallest relevant toolset and retrieve only necessary workspace data.
Read current state and preserve unspecified fields before every update.
Confirm the exact target, action, cost, and irreversible impact before external or destructive operations.
anti_patterns: Do not request credentials in chat or place secrets in files, commands, logs, or prompts.
Do not infer tool arguments, identifiers, availability, or prices from static examples.
Do not retry non-idempotent actions or claim success without checking the returned state.

faq.question: What does this skill connect to?
faq.answer: It connects supported clients to Famulor's hosted MCP server and uses the toolsets enabled for the authenticated workspace.

faq.question: Which clients are supported?
faq.answer: The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does the skill need my API key in chat?
faq.answer: No. Use the client's OAuth flow or a secure server credential path, and never paste keys into chat.

faq.question: Can it send calls or messages?
faq.answer: Yes, when the required tool, scope, consent, and explicit user authorization are present.

faq.question: Can it change billing or purchase phone numbers?
faq.answer: It can access supported billing and telephony workflows, but material cost and exact actions require authorization.

faq.question: What happens when a tool is unavailable?
faq.answer: The skill should report the limitation, follow returned recovery guidance, and avoid claiming any unverified result.
